reviews.text:
I feel so lucky to have had Arc Vet recommended to me about eight years ago by a doctor friend. Not only is their medicine top-notch and I know my dog is in the best hands, but every single person who works at the practice embraces its friendly, knowledgeable and helpful ethos. Thank you to the whole team for all you have done: to Richard for removing a fractured carnassial (and teaching me a rather resonant phrase) a few years ago, and to Emma for sorting out Tonto's ear this morning which had been causing both him and me a lot of bother.
A special thank you also to Holly, who as a nurse takes the combination of compassion and professionalism to a new level

Even though it is 45 mins away by bus, I continue to travel with my cat to Arc vets. The reception staff are kind and helpful both in person and on the phone. The appointments are available at useful times and I have always been fitted in quickly for serious issues. My poor elderly cat has had 2 separate operations at Arc in the last year and I couldn't have asked for more. The staff understand how nervous she is about coming in and always try to find an alternative (eg me sending in photos of her progress after operation, them emailing me advice). I find that Arc vets never try to get more money out of you than you need to part with, always giving you a range of options. This means I trust them to always be suggesting the best course of action for my cat. Highly recommend.
Great service and pet care. Rosie was in and out quickly and she was managed extremely well with very straight forward instructions.

Our dog had her second mastectomy done in this practice and it was so much better than the previous one at a different vet practice and the vets took an extensive amount of time to discuss all possibilities via an email with a high level of detail. Both myself and my husband are scientists, so we had several questions, and these were addressed extensively. Furthermore, the lady who performed the surgery did incredible job and we could see the craftsman of her skills. Our dogs recovery was so much faster than previously and she is still happy to go to the vet. They genuinely care, do not overcharge, and are happy to create an extensive and detailed description of the treatment and the justification. Thank you. Grateful Aida owners ❤️

I strongly advise against bringing your pets here. We have just transferred our senior cat to a new practice and filed a formal grievance with the RCVS (the Royal College of Veterinary Surgeons, the UK's veterinary regulator) regarding the lack of clinical governance and patient care at Arc Veterinary Centre. When we raised our concerns in writing, the Principal's only substantive response was to suggest the complaint had been AI-assisted, as though that undermined the facts which came directly from his own clinical records.
During a recent consult, the attending vet failed to read our cat's clinical history before seeing him. She was so convinced his symptoms indicated diabetes that she showed my partner photographs of cats with diabetes-induced plantigrade stance, all while failing to check her own records, which documented the actual cause three years prior. This led to a passive-aggressive atmosphere where my partner was made to feel as though she had neglected his care, even while she attempted to correct the history in the room. Furthermore, despite being fully aware of how severely stressed he was at the clinic, when my partner collected his new medication and was told he would need to return in three weeks for a follow-up blood draw, no Gabapentin had been prescribed alongside it. My partner had to request it at the desk, only to be told no vet was available to authorise it.
When we raised a formal internal complaint about this lack of continuity of care, the Principal, Richard Harper, outright refused to investigate the clinical oversight. Instead, he attempted to deflect responsibility by criticising our interaction with his reception staff, effectively ignoring the fact that his own vet had failed to include the necessary sedation in the care plan in the first place. Because Arc Vet operates outside of the voluntary RCVS Practice Standards Scheme (PSS), the Principal is the only safeguard for clinical governance, a duty he completely failed to uphold here.
We also experienced inconsistent and opaque billing practices. A consultation fee was applied for a routine procedural blood draw, removed under pressure when we challenged it, and then reinstated for an identical follow-up procedure three weeks later. When we raised this, the Principal defended it as fixed, transparent policy, directly contradicting his own staff's documented notes.
If you want a practice that reads your pet's medical history, maintains clinical oversight, and operates with integrity, look elsewhere.

**UPDATE**

To clarify: my complaint was not "vexatious." It was concluded because regulatory frameworks severely limit the RCVS's ability to act unless an extremely high threshold of misconduct is met, a gap currently being addressed through reform. The RCVS staff who handled my case expressed genuine frustration at these limitations, and your practice has benefited directly from this legislative shortfall.

There is nothing "bizarre" about our account, it is a precise, evidence-based summary supported by your own records. Your notes from 28th January 2023 explicitly document Milo's plantigrade stance and his history of hip dysplasia and degenerative joint disease, three years ago, not five. Furthermore, the Metacam prescribed on that date confirms you were actively managing this condition. Claiming this had not been investigated since 2021 is factually incorrect.

Additionally, charging a consultation fee for a routine blood draw attended solely by nursing staff, when no consultation occurred, is a misrepresentation of service, not a fixed fee policy.

People with "vexatious" complaints do not have them formally logged by the RCVS, engage with the Head of Policy on legislative reform, or receive personal correspondence regarding the government's White Paper on veterinary regulation.

Mischaracterising requests for transparency as "hostility" is an obvious attempt to deflect from clinical oversight failures. Having transitioned to a practice that prioritises clinical integrity over egotistical posturing, I consider this matter closed.

I can’t quite put into words how grateful I am to Richard at arc vets… I came into the practice very worried about my cat . I am quite an anxious person if I can’t find a solution to a problem. I had been to a different vet twice to try and find out what was going on and I needed a second opinion and someone to explain things to me. Richard immediately put my mind at ease and explained things with such clarity, including his reasoning for making certain decisions and the calculations he was making in his head as to why. He drew me two diagrams, said all the right things to put my mind at ease whilst being realistic and also made me laugh. I can’t really put into words how much I needed to see him that day and how much he really helped me and my cat. My cat is doing better now and so am I. I would recommend this vet and I won’t be going anywhere else. Thanks arc vets and Richard!!

Absolutely adore the team here at Arc Vet Centre, Muswell Hill. The experience has truly been so kind, considerate, and fast moving - I honestly couldn't think of a better vets to bring my cat Honey too in the area. What a lovely team. Just want to shout this out as the care and consideration to my elderly cat has been second to none with every vet I have seen in the practise. Huge thanks.

Absolutely outstanding experience with Arc Vet. From the moment you walk in, the team are warm, welcoming, and genuinely caring. They took incredible care of my dog, Luna, and made both of us feel completely at ease throughout.

The vets are clearly very knowledgeable and take the time to explain everything in a way that’s easy to understand, without ever making you feel rushed. You can tell they truly care about the animals they treat, which makes all the difference.

The whole team goes above and beyond, and the level of care and professionalism is second to none. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Arc Vet to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate practice

My two cats have had a bit of an unlucky year with a couple of bouts of gastrointestinal issues and The Arc have fitted them in at top speed every time. The vets are very knowledgeable and give common-sense advice without upselling and the people who take the calls are friendly and supportive. I really appreciate that they’re only a short bus ride away, and it’s great they’re an independent vet. The standard of care is very high and I would recommend this practice to anyone. Thank you all so much.

I’m not the easiest customer to please, as I have a suspicious attitude due to a bad experience with a previous vet. However, I’ve been with Arc for a couple of years and they’ve always provided a decent service for basic procedures.

Recently, my big dog, Rocco, had to go in for a dental issue, and Arc handled it perfectly. I was worried about the cost and suspicious of any unnecessary or inflated charges, having had previous negative experiences elsewhere. When I expressed my concerns, one of the surgery vets addressed them, and then Richard, the main vet, called to ask and explain the cost and what he would be doing. They called mid surgery to advise of their finding and provided options of how to proceed. The  options were very fair and reasonable with the cost. I am very grateful to them for their time, commitment, and support. I’m writing this review to assist people like me who have had bad experiences and want a vet they can trust. Thank you to all the Staff at Arc - Best wishes Michelle,
Rocco and Molly.
Wonderful caring vets. And reasonable price compared to others for a great service. My dog Rex goes there happily and is treated with care and kindness.

Our much loved family dog Bella recently had surgery at Arc Vets. Everyone at the vets are so caring and so professional. Bella was so well looked after. They are all absolutely brilliant! Thank you to everyone at Arc Vets for everything you did for Bella. You are all amazing!

Helped me twice now with my hamsters and I couldn’t have asked for better. So compassionate and caring for both us and the animals. Very reasonable pricing too. Treated them with such care and no hesitation to help (especially when other vets had let us down) thank you so much would recommend to anyone.
So kind and helpful, we can always get an appointment when we need one and the staff seem to genuinely care.

We have been using Arc Vets for nearly 5 years, for our Cavalier Kings Charles, Milo and his feline sisters, Holly and Poppy. We have nothing but good things to say about the team, they are always genuinely happy to see you, and are only a phone call away for phone advice and help. The team never ‘push’  unnecessary treatments, and are very patient and understanding when we, as over anxious pet parents, turn up with one of our brood, with what usually turns out to be some minor ailment. We are extremely happy that we found this practice 😄

First of all, a huge thank you to the vet — my cat felt very calm in his hands. He had an eye inflammation, which looked very scary at first, but after the visit, it cleared up in less than a week. Thank you to the team for taking such good care of our little friends!

We came to Arc Vets after a bad experience at another vets - a chain vets in the area. It's always an excellent sign when a vet tells you that a treatment is not necessary even when they could have just done it and charged you. We've since been with them for a few years, and they've been consistently great.

The reception staff are unfailingly friendly and helpful, and the veterinary staff are kind, calm, explanatory, no-nonsense, and no-fuss. They're always happy to give advice, which has been much appreciated. You can tell everyone there really cares about animals and about their standard of care.

Excellent vets - highly recommend! Keep an eye out for a photo of our two tuxedo cats on the wall in reception ;)

Little Buddy (the Aussie shepherd) has had a difficult couple of months with gastrointestinal issues and pancreatitis. Vet Richard and Emma have been outstanding in his care and we are so thankful. Special shout out to Emma who has such a wonderful bedside manner and is so patient in answering our questions as two somewhat overbearing dog parents! We have found Richard to be similarly empathetic and pragmatic in Buddy’s care - he never tried to push procedures or medicine on us. Thank you for taking such good care of our Buds and always being available for him. We are very grateful to have this vet nearby.

Thank you also to the other lovely women in the clinic - Jasmine, Danielle and the other names which I have now forgotten!

Side note: they are extremely fairly priced. My local vet (on pond square in Highgate Village) wanted to charge me £50 for a plastic cone to go around buddy’s neck after he was licking his stomach a lot. Arc charged me £11. I find them exceptionally nice and very fairly priced which is why I am willing to drive to get there, even when I have other vets on my doorstep. Will not be changing any time soon.

We have been going to Arc Vets for the last 12 years, and they have been fantastic.  The wonderful team of vets and nurses have supported us with various pets from hamsters to cats, and our beloved Rosie, a 12-year-old cockerpoo with recent onset diabetes.  Rosie's diagnosis rocked our world, and if it had not been for the patience and kindness of everyone at Arc I don't think we would have coped.  Rosie now has her injections without fuss and, thanks to the team, is doing well.  One of the great things about the support at Arc is the fact that they always respond to emails and phone calls by return, which is so reassuring.  They are all lovely, genuinely caring people, and I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a vet in North London.
Thanks Gianluca!

What a brilliant practice! I found an injured hedgehog today and was refused help from MediVet, Vets4Pets and other practices. Despite many of these chains refusing to help me the people in here were kind, caring and immediately helped without hesitation - will definitely be using their services for my own pets.

I can recommend Arc Vet Centre with great confidence to anybody living in north London, they will do an amazing job however small or big your dog’s need. Our Flakey, had developed some mammary lumps and we took her for a surgery, the doctors were very prompt to set up the surgery and did an amazing job. Flakey is now resting and recovering and we can’t wait to see her being springy and sprite as usual.
Kind, patient and friendly. They made my rescue cat Lucky feel at ease. Thank you for all round great service and care.
Lovely vets - highly recommend- every vet we have met here over two years has been great.
Excellent service
Thanks for  replacing  the batteries on Wizard. My cat now does miaw miaw and prrrrrrrr prrrrrrr again 🤣🤣🤣 …
Lovely staff. Helpful and spotless reception area. Off street parking big plus.

We came to Dr. Richard’s surgery for the first time in 2021, when my Tobbi (Bichon Frise) was 12 years of age. He was suffering from adenoma growing and bleeding near his rear end.
We visited a few vets before we found Dr. Richard and they all were giving us different reasons not to do the operation, like age thing, difficult area, for some of them it was a challenge. But when we came to Dr. Richard, he had a look and without any hesitation and with an absolute confidence he said “Yes, I can do that”
And he did a perfect job.
It was such a happiness to see our little cutie pie playing and running again.
Unfortunately Tobbi's condition is a recurring benign adenomas issue and we have to come to Dr. Richard to remove new adenomas when they appear.
The danger of the operation on this area that the dog can become faecally incontinent, but thanks to Dr. Richard’s skills, our Tobbi is still ok after having several operations on this area.
Dr. Richard is a very skilled surgeon, he always gives us the right advice and he does perfect internal stitches, which are not visible, no need to look after, the wound is clean and not bleeding compared to external stitches.
All the stuff we met at Arc Vet - receptionist Jasmine, nurse, they are always very helpful, friendly and caring.
We live far away, in West London, but we are willing to come to Arc Vet because of the professionals who work here.
Extremely kind staff! Great prices too ☺️
Best Vet in North London, took great care of Molly and offer great value
